calibration is informational and requires human review.";}else{status="calibration_ready";reason="Confidence-weighted underwriting calibration is ready.";next="WF-252";}}const adjusted_mao=Number.isFinite(base_mao)?base_mao*factor:null;return[{json:{workflow:"WF-251",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,performance_status,historical_sample_size:sample,confidence,net_delta:Number.isFinite(net_delta)?net_delta:null,margin_delta:Number.isFinite(margin_delta)?margin_delta:null,base_mao:Number.isFinite(base_mao)?base_mao:null,adjustment_factor:factor,adjusted_mao,calibration_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="calibration_ready",next_workflow:next,calibration_policy:{high_sample:"0.95/1.03",medium_sample:"0.97/1.02",low_sample:"human_review"}}}];
